events.title: Strike a Pot: A Runway to a Sustainable Future
events.description:
In-game na naman sila sa 𝒈𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒂-𝒈𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒂𝒉𝒂𝒏, para sa 𝒊𝒌𝒂𝒈𝒂𝒈𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒂 𝒏𝒈 𝒌𝒂𝒍𝒊𝒌𝒂𝒔𝒂𝒏! 🌿✨

Join us this 𝐀𝐩𝐫𝐢𝐥 𝟐𝟕, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟓 (𝟗:𝟎𝟎 𝐀𝐌–𝟒:𝟎𝟎 𝐏𝐌) at the 𝐁𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐧𝐠𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐧 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐂𝐨𝐧𝐟𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞 𝐂𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫 for 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐞 𝟐 of 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐢𝐤𝐞 𝐚 𝐏𝐨𝐭: 𝐀 𝐑𝐮𝐧𝐰𝐚𝐲 𝐭𝐨 𝐚 𝐒𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐅𝐮𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞—a celebration of creativity, inclusivity, and environmental stewardship! 🌱

From 𝒆𝒄𝒐-𝒄𝒉𝒊𝒄 𝒄𝒐𝒖𝒕𝒖𝒓𝒆 on the runway to 𝒉𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒔-𝒐𝒏 𝑫𝑰𝒀 𝒇𝒍𝒐𝒘𝒆𝒓 𝒑𝒐𝒕𝒔 made from recyclable materials, our talented participants will serve 𝐥𝐨𝐨𝐤𝐬 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐨𝐯𝐞 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐞𝐭 in a day filled with expression, exploration, and empowerment. 🌟

Let’s empower children with special needs to 𝐞𝐱𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐯𝐞𝐬, 𝐜𝐨𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐜𝐭 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐧𝐚𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞, and become 𝐟𝐢𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐞 𝐚𝐝𝐯𝐨𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐬 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐩𝐥𝐚𝐧𝐞𝐭. 🌍❤️

events.title: VLT: Volunteerism and Hunger
events.description:
🌍 𝙍𝙚𝙖𝙙𝙮 𝙩𝙤 𝙢𝙖𝙠𝙚 𝙖 𝙙𝙞𝙛𝙛𝙚𝙧𝙚𝙣𝙘𝙚? 🌱

The UST Volunteers for UNICEF, in collaboration with the Office for Student Affairs, will be conducting 𝓥𝓛𝓣: 𝓥𝓸𝓵𝓾𝓷𝓽𝓮𝓮𝓻𝓲𝓼𝓶 𝓪𝓷𝓭 𝓗𝓾𝓷𝓰𝓮𝓻 on 𝐌𝐚𝐫𝐜𝐡 𝟏𝟗𝐭𝐡 from 𝟏-𝟓 𝐏𝐌 at the 𝐔𝐒𝐓 𝐂𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐚𝐥 𝐋𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐲 𝐀𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐭𝐨𝐫𝐢𝐮𝐦. Dive into discussions on zero hunger and discover how your volunteer spirit can make a lasting impact! 🥗🍽️

Be inspired by well-experienced speakers and learn how to apply their insights to create a better community. ✨

📅 Mark your calendars & don’t miss out!

events.title: Giving with UVU: A Christmas Wonderland Adventure
events.description:
🌟 𝓣𝓱𝓮 𝓼𝓽𝓸𝓬𝓴𝓲𝓷𝓰𝓼 𝓪𝓻𝓮 𝓱𝓾𝓷𝓰, 𝓽𝓱𝓮 𝓽𝓻𝓮𝓮 𝓲𝓼 𝓵𝓲𝓽—𝓵𝓮𝓽 𝓽𝓱𝓮 𝓒𝓱𝓻𝓲𝓼𝓽𝓶𝓪𝓼 𝓶𝓪𝓰𝓲𝓬 𝓫𝓮𝓰𝓲𝓷! 🌟

On December 1st, the Oompa Loompas from the 𝑼𝑽𝑼 𝑪𝒉𝒐𝒄𝒐𝒍𝒂𝒕𝒆 𝑭𝒂𝒄𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒚 🍫 will be making children's wishes come true! 🪄

𝔾𝕚𝕧𝕚𝕟𝕘 𝕨𝕚𝕥𝕙 𝕌𝕍𝕌: 𝔸 ℂ𝕙𝕣𝕚𝕤𝕥𝕞𝕒𝕤 𝕎𝕠𝕟𝕕𝕖𝕣𝕝𝕒𝕟𝕕 𝔸𝕕𝕧𝕖𝕟𝕥𝕦𝕣𝕖 🎄 is a community development project held at ℚℂ 𝕂𝕒𝕓𝕒𝕙𝕒𝕘𝕚 ℂ𝕖𝕟𝕥𝕖𝕣 𝕗𝕠𝕣 ℂ𝕙𝕚𝕝𝕕𝕣𝕖𝕟 𝕨𝕚𝕥𝕙 𝔻𝕚𝕤𝕒𝕓𝕚𝕝𝕚𝕥𝕚𝕖𝕤 that aims to spread the spirit of Christmas through acts of charity, educational and recreational activities, as well as fun games. 🪁

Santa’s little helpers will join the Oompa Loompas in spreading the joy and spirit of Christmas from 8:00AM to 3:00PM! 🎁

events.title: Mahiwaga: Ang Madyik sa Wansapanataym ni Lola
events.description:
Mahiwagang Araw, UVU ✨

𝘏𝘢𝘯𝘥𝘢 𝘯𝘢 𝘣𝘢 𝘬𝘢𝘺𝘰𝘯𝘨 𝘮𝘢𝘬𝘪𝘣𝘢𝘩𝘢𝘨𝘪 𝘢𝘵 𝘮𝘶𝘭𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘵𝘶𝘬𝘭𝘢𝘴𝘪𝘯 𝘢𝘯𝘨 𝘬𝘪𝘴𝘭𝘢𝘱 𝘯𝘨 𝘬𝘶𝘭𝘵𝘶𝘳𝘢𝘯𝘨 𝘗𝘪𝘭𝘪𝘱𝘪𝘯𝘰? 👀

Sa pagbunga ng samu’t saring teknolohiya, nagiging abala ang mamamayan sa mga kinang at kagiliw-giliw na bagay na hatid nito. Gayunpaman, sa kabila ng positibong epekto, unti-unti ring napag-iiwanan ang mga nakasanayang tradisyon na siyang humubog sa pagkakakilanlan ng mga Pilipino.

Kaya naman ngayon buwan, malugod naming inihahandog ang 𝙈𝘼𝙃𝙄𝙒𝘼𝙂𝘼: 𝘼𝙣𝙜 𝙈𝙖𝙙𝙮𝙞𝙠 𝙨𝙖 𝙒𝙖𝙣𝙨𝙖𝙥𝙖𝙣𝙖𝙩𝙖𝙮𝙢 𝙣𝙞 𝙇𝙤𝙡𝙖 🌌 isang ‘two-phase community development project’ na layon turuan ang kabataan na muling pausbungin ang kahalagahan at tradisyon ng kulturang Pilipino sa pamamagitan ng ‘story-telling.’ Ito ay gaganapin sa 𝗡𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗵𝘃𝗶𝗹𝗹𝗲 𝟰𝗕 𝗘𝗹𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗼𝗼𝗹 (𝗠𝗮𝗿𝗶𝗹𝗮𝗼, 𝗕𝘂𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗮𝗻) kung saan iba’t ibang aktibidades ang naghihintay mula 𝟭𝟬:𝟬𝟬 𝗔𝗠 𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗴𝗮𝗻𝗴 𝟰:𝟬𝟬 𝗣𝗠. 📖

Kaya halina’t makibahagi sa 𝓶𝓪𝓱𝓲𝔀𝓪𝓰𝓪𝓷𝓰 kaganapang hatid ni Lola — wansapanataym sa kulturang kinagisnan. 🫧
